scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @caliburn/frontend lint && pnpm --filter @caliburn/frontend format:check && uv run --directory apps/backend --locked ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/backend --locked ruff format --check . && pnpm architecture:check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @caliburn/frontend typecheck && uv run --directory apps/backend --locked python -m mypy
scripts.test: pnpm test:scripts && uv run --directory apps/backend --locked python -m pytest tests/unit -q && pnpm --filter @caliburn/frontend test
scripts.test:integration: uv run --directory apps/backend --locked python -m pytest tests/integration -q
scripts.check: pnpm docs:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose run --rm app python -m caliburn.migrate upgrade head
